messages:
Laura N: Heads up — nightly vulnerability scan failed for multiple repos after yesterday's KMS key rotation. CI jobs are all erroring on decrypt.
Sam W: ugh, seen any error logs? short one please.
Laura N: here's the failing snippet from scanner logs:
```
2024-11-07T03:12:10Z ERROR trivy-scanner: failed to decrypt token: AccessDeniedException: "Cannot decrypt with key arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-rotated"
stack: github.com/redwood/scan/worker
```
Sam W: looks like the service account lost kms:Decrypt on the new key ARN. @Ankur P any IAM changes recently?
Ankur P: I reviewed the rotation PR — the key policy was replaced to a stricter policy for cross-account access. Scanner's role was supposed to be added but I don't see it in the new policy. tagging @Marco G who merged the rotation.
Marco G: yep, that was my PR. I scoped the key to the infra ops role and forgot the scanner role; bad oversight. Sorry.
Oncall SRE: sec-bot reported 18 failing pipelines and alerted pagers at 03:20. We're throttling notifications but noise is high. deploy-bot shows the rotation completed at 02:45.
sec-bot: Alert: KMSDecryptFailure x18 — affected services: trivy-worker, snyk-orchestrator, ghas-mirror. See runbook: https://internal/runbooks/kms-rotation
Laura N: short term: can we add the scanner role to the key policy (least-priv) and redeploy? That should restore decrypts quickly.
Ankur P: Agreed. I can craft a minimal policy patch granting kms:Decrypt to arn:aws:iam::123:role/scan-worker-role and open a PR. Will add a 30m window TTL for the principal to be removed after verification.
Marco G: if Ankur can push the patch, I'll approve and apply. After that, let's re-run a representative repo scan (small one) before unmuting full pipelines.
Sam W: also we should add retry/backoff to the scanner for KMS errors — right now it fails fast and bubbles noise. Filing a GH issue: https://gh/redwood/issues/scan-1820
Laura N: also propose an immediate suppression rule for the duplicated KMS alerts in alertmanager for 1h so oncall can focus on remediation.
Oncall SRE: I'll mute the alert group for 45m and mark the incident as "ongoing - KMS policy fix". Please post PR link when ready.
Ankur P: PR opened: https://git.internal/infra/kms/changes/pull/78 — minimal add of scan-worker-role with kms:Decrypt. request review from ops+security.
Marco G: approving now, applying to prod key. patch applied at 03:48.
deploy-bot: Deployment finished: kms-policy-update succeeded (apply-id: apply-2024-176999). No rolling restarts required.
Laura N: re-running a quick trivy job now.
Laura N: quick pass: repo 'api-shared' scan succeeded, no decrypt errors. yay :tada:
Sam W: nice. follow-ups: (1) add scanner role test to rotation checklist, (2) implement exponential retry and nicer logging, (3) add canary run post-rotation.
Ankur P: created follow-up tickets: scan-1821 (retry/backoff), scan-1822 (rotation checklist test), scan-1823 (canary job). ETA for fixes next sprint.
Marco G: I'll update rotation PR template and add a checklist item to include all dependent principals. PR: https://git.internal/infra/kms/changes/pull/79
Laura N: thanks all. I'll close the immediate triage once alerts unmute and 2 consecutive nightly scans pass. Marking this thread resolved for now.
Oncall SRE: unmuting alerts at 04:40 after verification. Incident status: resolved — follow-ups assigned.
sec-bot: Incident closed: KMS policy misconfig (cause: missing principal) — root cause: rotation PR omitted scanner role.
